name: Extract Document to Markdown
description: Extract the TEXT and IMAGES from a document and return them as Markdown. Supports PDF, HTML, image and AUDIO files. For audio (voice notes, opus/oga/mp3/m4a/wav/...) it returns the speech transcription. Embedded/extracted images are saved as files under /tmp and linked inline in the Markdown (never inlined as base64). Use this to actually READ the content of a PDF, an HTML page, an image (with OCR) or to TRANSCRIBE an audio file — unlike file_read, which only works for plain-text files and returns garbage on binary formats.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the document (.pdf, .html/.htm, an image like .png/.jpg, or an audio file like .oga/.mp3/.m4a/.wav)

language.description: Audio only: ISO language code (e.g. 'it', 'en') to skip auto-detection and improve transcription accuracy.

image_dir.description: Directory where extracted images are written. Defaults to a per-file folder under /tmp/myagent_extract.

max_pages.description: For PDFs: maximum number of pages to process.

ocr.description: Run OCR (tesseract, eng+ita) to extract text from image files. Ignored for PDF/HTML.
